locales.description: keyed by locale code, one entry per locale the site asked about for this component

built_for_version.description: 1.4.0: only when status is babilim_installed -- the component version the installed build was made for

newer_version.description: 1.4.0: only when status is babilim_installed, built_for_version differs from the version this call reported, and the reported version has no active build yet (an active build is expressed by update_available instead)

hardcoded_text_warning.description: 1.6.0: present and true only when status is babilim_installed or babilim_available AND the build named by this entry's build_id belongs to a component whose source has a substantial amount of user-visible text that is not passed through translation functions, so a language pack cannot cover it. Absent means no notice -- it does NOT mean the component is fully translatable. Never false

upload_pending.description: 1.5.0: true only when status is queued and THIS site holds an open (not yet completed) source upload for this component version -- the site should offer the same request action again so the upload can be resumed or cancelled

reason.description: generic reason code only when status is failed or unsupported; also present when status is babilim_installed and the installed build's local integrity check failed ("integrity_failed"); 1.5.0: also present when status is requestable because the last source upload was rejected ("source_rejected") or expired ("upload_expired")

updates.description: entries for (component, locale) pairs the site has ALREADY INSTALLED where the installed build_id differs from the current active build (includes the service rolling an active build back to an older build_no, which the site should pick up as a downgrade); shaped for direct injection into site_transient_update_plugins/themes. A (component, locale) the site has never installed never appears here, regardless of its status (e.g. babilim_available is not an update).

package.description: POST /v1/downloads {build_id} is the authoritative way to fetch it; this is an optional convenience pointer, relative to the API base URL

checkout.description: 1.7.0: true when the service offers checkout (POST /v1/sites/{id}/checkout is usable)

price.description: 1.7.0: present only when the service currently offers checkout to this site's deployment; a one-time price per site domain. Absent means the plugin shows no upgrade button.
